milestone: Typed gameplay save/load and safe native player replacement
implemented: Bounded allocation-free gameplay request queue and terminal ledger; memory-only capability/result queries.
C# Tick enqueues typed save/load requests; native owner services only after a committed simulation batch. Later-tick failure rolls back requests without disk writes.
Load stages a trusted replacement with fresh session/epoch, preserving source result and retry identities across replacement.
Uncertain write publication resolves through retained durable receipts; unresolved outcomes block new simulation and preserve operation identity.
Player queries current owner state without retaining a replaced Runtime reference; reset input, clock and audio at replacement.
Desktop automatic playback supports gameplay requests and pauses after load. Standalone bundles accept explicit external --save-root.
Services ABI 4 is required by both managed hosts, native artifacts and gameplay bundle runtime metadata.

review_fixes: Removed post-publication success-path allocations before no-throw runtime activation.
Kept receipt result and retained-generation observations under one slot lock.
Added explicit services ABI to packaged runtime metadata to reject mismatched same-version engines.
Audio replay oracle corrected from 1600 to 1536 frames: three complete 512-frame blocks, with the old partial tail discarded at replacement. No engine change for that correction.
limitations: Experimental fixed-entity logical snapshots with exact external content/module/schema binding; no arbitrary object serialization or general migrations.
Storage is synchronous and may hitch. Excluding serviced time from catch-up is not background I/O.
In-memory operation/retry histories and durable receipt history are bounded; unresolved publication can block progress.
